testcase.name: proxy refuses arbitrary URLs, unowned servers and unbound journals before any request
HTTP reservation is durable and pending before the owned backend receives the request
SDK origin, session/challenge cookies and JWT headers survive relay without entering evidence
approved local callback302 is preserved manually, and an external redirect is blocked
committed POST with a lost response is not replayed after proxy and journal restart
budget exhaustion refuses dispatch and keeps cleanup reserve after restart
expired target and over-size body fail closed without dispatching upstream
POST server500 retains an unknown write and timeout is bounded without automatic retry
read-only fixture budget inspection exposes counts without auth traffic or credential data
concurrent identical fixture POSTs share the in-flight barrier before upstream acceptance is known
fixture cleanup control requires the exact local owner nonce and never forwards to backend
committed POST with a refused redirect stays unknown and is held after restart
